positions.name: CalibrationSettledStatus
positions.frame: is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's 88.4 MHz calibration a settled, verified fact or still open/provisional?
positions.why: src-1 is Quill Ashgrove's direct, present-tense declaration that the calibration 'is now calibrated' and 'holds across the full observing band,' verified against the June reference plates; src-2 is the memo author's compressed restatement of the same instrument, frequency, and verification method under a 'Key decisions' header. Despite the shift in footing — a first-person scientific report versus a formalized record of decisions — both read the calibration the same directional way: as a completed, load-bearing fact rather than a pending or contested one. The tension worth naming is register/footing (personal verification act vs. institutional decision-record), not substance — both sides agree the matter is closed.
